PURBASHA GRAMIN BANK
(A fictional bank) · Ranchi Branch

Date: 10/10/2026

To,
Moumita Singh
197, Station Road, Ranchi, Jharkhand - 834001

Sub: Reminder for overdue instalments in Loan Account No. 477771536892

Dear Customer,

This is to inform you that 2 EMI(s) of ₹ 8,999.00 each in your above loan account are overdue since 10/08/2026. The total overdue amount is ₹ 17,998.00, and penal interest of ₹ 720.00 has been levied as per the sanction terms.

You are requested to pay ₹ 18,718.00 on or before 25/10/2026 to regularise the account.

Please note that if the dues are not cleared, the account will be classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) on 08/11/2026, which will affect your credit score, and the Bank may initiate recovery proceedings as per law.

If you have already paid, please ignore this letter.

Yours faithfully,
Branch Manager
